headline: Turkcell to Showcase Green Technology Investments at COP31 Climate Summit
summary: Turkish telecommunications company Turkcell announced plans to present its renewable energy, energy efficiency, and digital transformation investments at the COP31 climate summit.
why: Telecommunications operators are major energy consumers; investments in green energy can alter operating cost structures and ESG ratings.

impacts.name: Turkcell
impacts.why: Presentation of green investments at a climate summit may influence long-term corporate positioning.
